digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira family - value map management and boundary guards
propositions: The ticket-type map is duplicated in two locations under adapters/ (jira/outbound_fields.py and jira_datacenter/backend.py), mirroring the defect pattern from closed bug fe15
Both duplicate copies are content-identical (same four keys and values, differing only in key order), so unification preserves behavior on both Cloud and DC deployment paths
The boundary guard in test_jira_family_boundary_heldout.py covers STATUS and PRIORITY maps but not the TICKET-TYPE map, leaving no protection against future divergence or re-duplication

External consumer test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py reads _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE as a module attribute on outbound_fields, requiring the canonical definition to be imported and aliased to that name in both paths

The required fix follows the J2 pattern: relocate the single definition to adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py, import it under the _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE alias in both create paths, and extend the boundary guard to detect future copies

The implementation must use absolute imports (not relative) because these modules are loaded via spec_from_file_location with no package context in tests, where relative imports would raise ImportError
